body: 16 Nov 2026 ~08:05 UTC (lead): the Proxmox host was rebooted overnight (up 2 min at 07:57) and VM 108 did NOT come back by itself: it has onboot=0, so ANY host reboot in the owner's test week takes the test server down until someone starts it. I started it (qm start 108, nothing else; log: local/homelab-changes-2026-11-13.md entry 1aa; undo: qm shutdown 108). Checked read-only: image unchanged (sha-62cf7f0, the frozen pair), both containers healthy, database integrity_check ok, foreign_key_check empty, no errors in the log, the A35 reconnected. Question for the owner (his host, not changed by me): set 'qm set 108 --onboot 1'?
